rules: Only merged, non-draft pull requests with exactly one maintainer-applied impact label score.
Every scored pull request requires a non-author human approval.
Operators, bots, direct pushes, unmerged work, line counts, stars and self-approval score zero.
Points are public recognition only: not money, an airdrop, token utility or a claim on $dasha.

entries.basis: Editorial founding spot — not a measured interaction rank.

rules.x_linking: Requires X OAuth; a typed handle is not a linked account.
rules.selection: Editorial v0 requires public Dasha work and at least one public X evidence URL. A nomination is not entry.
rules.holder_credit: Deferred. If added, wallet ownership must be signed and public output is a capped opt-in badge, never balance or bag-size ranking.
